name: Album no Naka no Hohoemi
original_name: アルバムの中の微笑み
source:
You play as the male main character who returns to Japan after completing his Europe art studies. As a rich man's son you were allowed to travel around to seek education around the globe. Now that you have completed your quest, it's time to return to Japan...and marry Satsuki, your bride-to-be. There is a problem though, you have a maid that has been following you most of your life. She likes you. After arriving in Japan, you soon became the art teacher of an all girls school. Now three more girls join the wagon and they all want a piece of you alright. Who will you choose?

[Edited from [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=427&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
